work_handoff.title: N21｜Sixteen Guests Enter｜Candidate 01
requirements: Generate exactly one N21 Candidate 01 and stop for Product Owner review.
9:16 vertical cinematic audio-comic still.
Primary read must be a full cohort of sixteen participants entering the castle, not a six-character promotional ensemble.
Use a wide interior oblique entrance shot from inside the castle, laterally offset, looking diagonally back toward the still-open main doors.
Use layered depth with natural overlap and teammate sub-clusters. Do not stage the group in rows.
Represent exactly sixteen total participants if all figures are countable. If some are naturally occluded or cropped, the frame must still plausibly represent the complete sixteen-person cohort.
Maintain balanced male/female visual presentation at this story point: 8 male-presenting and 8 female-presenting across the cohort.
Su Xiaoxiao must visually present fully as the approved feminine character. Do not foreshadow the later gender reveal.
Ning Qiushui and Jun Luyuan remain identifiable through N20 continuity but are secondary, not hero subjects.
Su Xiaoxiao and Liao Jian may appear in the same loose mid-layer teammate cluster without comedy staging or camera-facing poses.
Wen Qingya appears separately in the mid-side layer, preferably with round-frame glasses readable if natural, with a quiet observant presence.
Guang Yong appears in a rear-mid or threshold cluster with his established short, slightly chubby silhouette; do not stage him asking Neil a question.
The remaining ten participants must be distinct grounded adults with varied hairstyles, clothing, height and body type. No clones.
Neil must not appear.
All participants are living-looking humans at this moment; do not render them as transparent, glowing, undead or spectral ghosts.
Movement must read as people who have found their teammates and are filtering inward. Use varied gait phases and natural cluster spacing.
Open doors remain visible behind the cohort as spatial continuity.
Exterior daylight stays concentrated at the doorway; do not flood the interior floor or deeper bodies with hard sunlight.
Mid/foreground interior lighting is dim and warm, dominated by sconces, candles or chandeliers.
Scene remains CASTLE_ENTRANCE → INTERIOR TRANSITION ZONE. Do not establish the full First Hall.
AST_IMG_000052 controls architecture and open-door state but not exact camera angle or exterior-dominant lighting.
N20 controls immediate visual, lighting and Ning/Jun appearance continuity but must not force two-person dominance or its exact pose.
Named character sheets control identity only; do not rotate characters toward camera merely to show their faces.
If face visibility conflicts with natural group movement, show less face rather than creating a posed lineup.
exclusions: six named characters grouped together as a hero lineup
Neil anywhere in the sixteen-person cohort
Wen Qingya already confronting or analyzing Ning Qiushui
Su Xiaoxiao and Liao Jian comedy beat
hard exterior sunlight flooding deep interior
